rationale: Pins the two non-call reference constructs on their own grammar nodes: `handle_operator` (@helper, @pkg.f) and `metaclass_operator` (?Widget). A reference is distinct from a call, so `?Widget` must never be published as a call, and the handle's identifier must not also be published as a plain `uses` read (references is the stronger, correct label for a name captured as a handle). The local function `helper` is declared in the same file, so its handle edge is structural; `Widget` and `pkg.f` are not declared here and stay inferred.
